description: This file appears to be a PHP script used for testing the integration with GitLab's API. It sets up configuration for accessing GitLab repositories, initializes a system object for API interaction, and performs operations to retrieve repository file trees. It includes code for setting API URL, project ID, and testing retrieval of repository file structures, demonstrating interaction with GitLab's REST API.

classes.name: gitlabrestInterface
classes.description: A class that handles communication with the GitLab REST API, including retrieving configuration and API client.

methods.name: getCfg
methods.description: Returns the configuration object used for GitLab API interactions.

methods.name: getAPIClient
methods.description: Creates and returns an API client instance to communicate with GitLab.
